production_abstraction: Typed program plus resolved AIR must be encoded into one model-9 CSIR envelope at the shared compiler choke point, and only the linked Lean zero verdict may construct a FormalSecurityReport.
Resolved AIR reads and writes must agree with emitted SSA records, and every extracted CFG predecessor transfer must retain its source version or have a checked operand in the destination phi.
Retained-v8 semantic records must carry declared labels, policy classes, sinks, releases, guards, and CT-source policy without accepting Rust-computed taint verdicts.
Model-9 host, actor, FFI, and root declarations must authorize occurrence evidence only through the production v9 verifier, then feed the Public raw-machine corollary.
Retained-v8 acceptance must supply the static-safe premise used by the unsanitized raw security-event machine and its equal-length SecretCT release theorem.
Capability origins, restriction, split, draw, control-flow meet, slot meet, sinks, and releases must be derived by the Lean checker and remain backed by the retained Rust/Z3 compatibility gate.
Path-affine consumption must use verifier-produced branch, fallthrough, loop, and break states, while retained ownership remains a mandatory differential gate.
Signed quantity cells and normalized literal-RHS difference constraints must stay in the supported zero-anchored fragment and reject unsupported cross-cell constraints.
The v8 semantic suffix and v9 declaration envelope must preserve exact constructor inventories, owner order, operand spans, arities, CFG targets, and boundary identities.
The composition profile does not retire the retained Rust/Z3 gates; the release evidence remains non-retirement-eligible until SR-017 exit evidence exists.
